details: Bitcoin briefly fell to an intraday low of $57,800.19 on July 1, 2026, before paring some losses to trade around $58,904.32. This dip pushed the Crypto Fear & Greed Index to 11, marking a new cycle low and indicating "Extreme Fear" in the market. Solana, however, emerged as a standout performer among major assets, showing positive weekly momentum. The broader market is grappling with ETF selling pressure, decreased liquidity, and a stronger dollar, leading to a consolidation phase.
title: Bitcoin Faces Pressure as Price Dips to $58K Amidst "Extreme Fear"

details: "Ethereum Institutional," a new independent non-profit, launched on July 1, 2026, aiming to accelerate the institutional adoption of Ethereum, its Layer 2s, and the overall ecosystem. This follows the launch of another research non-profit, Ethlabs, nine days prior. Backed by major corporate holders like BitMine and SharpLink Gaming, these initiatives seek to attract institutional interest despite Ether (ETH) trading near $1,600, approximately 67% below its August 2025 peak.
title: Ethereum Institutional Initiative Launched to Drive Adoption

details: American Bitcoin Corp. (Nasdaq: ABTC) announced a 1-for-15 reverse stock split for its common stock, effective July 2, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET. The move, approved by shareholders, is intended to increase the per-share price and help the company maintain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement. Class A common stock is expected to begin trading on a reverse split-adjusted basis on July 6, 2026.
title: American Bitcoin Announces 1-for-15 Reverse Stock Split

details: XRP rallied on July 1, 2026, following Ripple's proposal for a native lending protocol on the XRP Ledger (XRPL). This protocol would enable financial institutions to borrow digital assets without having to sell their holdings, thereby expanding the network's capabilities in institutional finance and potentially reducing sell pressure on XRP. The news contributed to a positive momentum for XRP and the broader crypto market, which saw a 2.93% increase in total market capitalization.
title: Ripple Proposes XRPL Lending Protocol, XRP Rallies

details: Bullish (NYSE: BLSH), an institutionally focused global digital asset platform, launched the "Bullish Closing Cross" on July 1, 2026. This is the first daily call auction for spot Bitcoin, designed to provide a single, transparent closing price for BTC. The initiative aims to address a structural gap in institutional digital asset markets, offering a deterministic daily benchmark for ETFs, index funds, and institutional portfolios, similar to how equity markets operate.
title: Bullish Launches "Closing Cross" for Spot Bitcoin Trading
